properties.name: Kara Timurpaşa Cami
properties.description: Historical mosque made in 1573 by Ottoman sultan Yıldırım Beyazıt's amir Kara Timurtaş Paşa (Black Timurtash Pasha). Restorated in 1802 (lost most of original design) and still in use.
